dialogues.speaker: Matsumoto
dialogues.text: Yes, that's right. What's the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Matsumoto
dialogues.text: You're asking me to taste the food, so obviously you should be the one who pays or makes it for me.

dialogues.speaker: Matsumoto
dialogues.text: It would be difficult to be objective if you asked me to pay for the food. The price of the dish would affect the result.

dialogues.speaker: Matsumoto
dialogues.text: Only through a trade with no exchange of money can there be a fair review.
